summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader without running any code, per instructions. Changes: (1) new monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and private helper _resolve_path, using only os and json and raising ValueError for all failures; (2) monai/data/__init__.py gained an explicit import of load_decathalon_datalist; (3) docs/source/data.rst gained a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with an autofunction entry after the Utilities automodule; (4) new tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist containing test_seg_values, test_cls_values, test_seg_no_basedir, and test_seg_no_labels, each cleaning up its temp directory in finally. Verification was limited to reading: awk confirmed no line over 120 characters in the new and edited Python files; black and flake8 were not run and tests were not executed. Choices: missing image/label fields are skipped rather than raising; non-object top-level JSON raises the missing-key ValueError; all four parameters and the return are annotated with base_dir as Optional[str]. Nothing was committed.
